summary: The frozen direct null-argument claim does not require a harness update: the old harness calls Parse and never calls XMLDocument::DeleteNode directly. This focus assessment does not establish coverage of every obligation.

claims.necessity_reason: The complete harness entry has no direct XMLDocument::DeleteNode call, so the frozen operation is outside its operational surface.

before.requirement: A direct null argument reaches the nonnull assertion before the null guard.
before.reason: The old harness does not directly call XMLDocument::DeleteNode.

after.requirement: A direct null argument returns before the document assertion.
after.reason: The old harness still has no direct XMLDocument::DeleteNode call. The shown destructor passes a nonnull currentChild to its DeleteNode call.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The changed destructor calls DeleteNode only while currentChild is nonnull.

claims.comparison_reason: The null-argument behavior changed, but the same old harness does not perform the frozen direct call on either side.
